import urllib.request, urllib.parse, re, html
queries=['"OSS-Fuzz" "10129"','"10129" "OSS-Fuzz"','"oss-fuzz.com/42470146"','"42470146" "issue"','"10129" "BoringSSL"']
for q in queries:
 url='https://www.bing.com/search?q='+urllib.parse.quote(q)
 print('\nQUERY',q)
 req=urllib.request.Request(url,headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0','Accept-Language':'en-US,en;q=0.9'})
 try:
  data=urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=20).read(50000).decode('utf-8','ignore')
  text=re.sub('<[^>]+>',' ',data)
  text=html.unescape(re.sub(r'\s+',' ',text))
  print(text[:3000])
 except Exception as e: print('ERR',e)
